collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE VI: LAVASTONES AND THE SCHOOLS OF THOUGHT (LCF-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Lavastones, the glowing orange-pink stones of Isola's lore, found on beaches and falling from the sky, and what they cost; and the island's schools of thought, Nature, Science, Spiritualism and Magic, arguing with and borrowing from each other.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A healer wants to crush a lavastone into a stew for a very sick villager: use it, or try ordinary medicine first.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A fever has gripped the village, and one old fisher is not getting better. (subject) has a lavastone the elders have kept for years, and wants to crush a sliver of it into the healing stew. (friend) says nobody knows what the stone does to a body that weak, and the old remedies should be tried first. What should they do?

choices.label: Crush the Stone Into the Stew

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) grinds a sliver of the stone into the pot. The stew glows faintly. The old fisher drinks it, sleeps for a day and a night, and wakes with the fever gone and a ringing in (other.his/her) ears that never quite stops. (subject) cannot stop shaking for an hour after holding the stone.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) tries every remedy the healers know. The fisher's fever breaks slowly, over a week, and (other.he/she) is weak for a long time afterwards. Everyone wonders if the stone would have been faster. (friend) does not regret it.
